import iniconfig

def read_config_value(ini_data, section, key):
    # Create an IniConfig instance without stripping inline comments
    config = iniconfig.IniConfig.parse(data=ini_data, strip_inline_comments=False)
    
    # Retrieve the value from the specified section and key
    value = config.get(section, key, fallback=None)
    
    # Return the stripped value without inline comments
    return value.strip() if value is not None else None
